page.layout: One printed title page, centred. Title block in the upper two-thirds, then a printer's ornament, the place name, and the imprint line at the foot. The faint mirrored lines across the page are show-through from the reverse and are not transcribed.

main_text.l: ad diem 22 Sept. An. M. DC XIV. [?]

page.notes: The printer's ornament between "Basileenses." and "BASILEÆ" is a woodcut/typographic device, not text, so it is not transcribed. A faint oval library or ownership stamp sits at the bottom centre and a blue library stamp at the top right; both are left out. Show-through from the reverse side appears as reversed, faint lines (for example the mirrored "METEORIS", "SAMUELE WERENELSIO", and "JOACHIMUS LYDIUS" lines), and these are not printed on this side. The lines for the date and the "loco horis solitis" line are at low contrast in the scan and are uncertain, marked [?]. The "Eloq. Prof." line is also uncertain in its exact form.
